g.text: Empty Safavid courtyard, afternoon light. The bench at center holds a folded letter.
DIST. AZAN · COURTYARD AMBIENCE · FAINT WIND
Maryam crosses the courtyard. The camera pans right, settling on the bench.
FOOTSTEPS ON STONE · DIST. AZAN CONT.
She sees the letter on the bench
She stops mid-stride. The folded letter is on the bench. Camera dollies in.
Insert — the letter, dust on it
Her fingertip enters frame. The folded paper. Dust on the surface. She hesitates.
Reaction — she reads the first line
Her eyes find the first line. Something inside her shifts. She does not lower the paper.
MARYAM (V.O., whisper): "پدر آمد. اما دیر آمد."
She sits on the bench, alone. Camera cranes up. The courtyard absorbs her.
SOLO TAR · WIND BUILDS · FADE TO SC 5

svg.text: Scene total: ~24s · Coverage: master + singles + insert + crane-out · Notes: turning point on SH 5; CU is earned.
